items.source: For a NULL value read from the database, an attempt will be made to call the corresponding setter method with null, but in the case of Java primitives this will result in a TypeMismatchException by default. To ignore NULL database values for all primitive properties in the target class, set the primitivesDefaultedForNullValue flag to true. See setPrimitivesDefaultedForNullValue(boolean) for details.
items.translation: 对于从数据库读取的 `NULL` 值，系统将尝试调用对应的 setter 方法并传入 `null`；但在 Java 基本类型的情况下，默认会抛出 TypeMismatchException。若要忽略目标类中所有基本类型属性的 `NULL` 数据库值，请将 `primitivesDefaultedForNullValue` 标志设置为 `true`。有关详细信息，请参阅 setPrimitivesDefaultedForNullValue(boolean)。

items.source: If you need to map to a target class which has a data class constructor — for example, a Java record or a Kotlin data class — use DataClassRowMapper instead.
items.translation: 如果需要对具有数据类构造器的目标类进行映射——例如 Java 的record或 Kotlin 的data类——请使用DataClassRowMapper。

items.source: The default implementation calls JdbcUtils.getResultSetValue(java.sql.ResultSet, int, Class) using the type of the specified PropertyDescriptor.
items.translation: 默认实现调用JdbcUtils.getResultSetValue(java.sql.ResultSet, int, Class)，使用指定的PropertyDescriptor的类型。

items.source: To facilitate mapping between columns and properties that don't have matching names, try using underscore-separated column aliases in the SQL statement like "select fname as first_name from customer", where first_name can be mapped to a setFirstName(String) method in the target class.
items.translation: 为了解决列名与属性名不匹配时的映射问题，请在 SQL 语句中使用下划线分隔的列别名，例如 `"select fname as first_name from customer"`，其中 `first_name` 可以映射到目标类中的 `setFirstName(String)` 方法。

items.source: If this flag is set to true and you use an ignored primitive property value from the mapped bean to update the database, the value in the database will be changed from NULL to the current value of that primitive property. That value may be the property's initial value (potentially Java's default value for the respective primitive type), or it may be some other value set for the property in the default constructor (or initialization block) or as a side effect of setting some other property in the mapped bean.
items.translation: 如果将此标志设置为 `true`，并且您使用映射 Bean 中被忽略的原始属性值来更新数据库，则数据库中的该值将从 `NULL` 更改为该原始属性的当前值。该值可能是属性的初始值（可能是相应原始类型的 Java 默认值），也可能是默认构造函数（或初始化块）中设置的该属性的其他值，或者是设置映射 Bean 中的其他属性所产生的副作用。

items.source: Default is a DefaultConversionService. This provides support for java.time conversion and other special types.
items.translation: 默认值为一个DefaultConversionService。它支持java.time转换和其他特殊类型。

items.source: The default implementation applies the configured ConversionService, if any. Can be overridden in subclasses.
items.translation: 默认实现会应用配置的ConversionService（如果有）。可以在子类中重写此方法。

items.source: The default implementation calls JdbcUtils.getResultSetValue(java.sql.ResultSet, int, Class).
items.translation: 默认实现调用 JdbcUtils.getResultSetValue(java.sql.ResultSet, int, Class)。
对于许多常见类型，为目标类中的属性提供了映射——例如：String、boolean、Boolean、byte、Byte、short、Short、int、Integer、long、Long、float、Float、double、Double、BigDecimal、java.util.Date 等。

items.source: Please note that this class is designed to provide convenience rather than high performance. For best performance, consider using a custom RowMapper implementation.
items.translation: 请注意，该类旨在提供便利性而非高性能。若要获得最佳性能，请考虑使用自定义的RowMapper实现。

items.source: Default is false, accepting unpopulated properties in the target bean.
items.translation: 默认值为false，接受目标 Bean 中未填充的属性。

items.source: Default is false, throwing an exception when nulls are mapped to Java primitives.
items.translation: 默认值为false，当将空值映射到 Java 基本类型时会抛出异常。

items.source:
Column values are mapped based on matching the column name (as obtained from
result set meta-data) to public setters in the target class for the corresponding
properties. The names are matched either directly or by transforming a name
separating the parts with underscores to the same name using "camel" case.
items.translation: 列值根据列名（从结果集元数据中获取）与目标类中对应属性的公共 setter 进行映射。名称匹配方式有两种：直接匹配，或将使用下划线分隔各部分名称转换为“驼峰”（camel）命名法后匹配。

items.source:
Subclasses may override this method to customize the mapped names,
adding to or removing from the set determined by this base method
(which returns the property name in lower-case and underscore-based
form), or replacing the set completely.
items.translation: 子类可以重写此方法来自定义映射名称，向或从此基础方法确定的集合中添加或删除元素（该基础方法返回小写且基于下划线的属性名），或者完全替换该集合。

items.source: By default, conversions will happen within the US locale.
items.translation: 默认情况下，转换将在美国区域设置中进行。

items.source: Any upper case letters are converted to lower case with a preceding underscore.
items.translation: 任何大写字母都会转换为小写，并在其前面添加一个下划线。
